capability_need.question_or_operation: Determine whether the admitted evidence supports an agent's proposed vendor-status update before the downstream workflow relies on it.
capability_need.consuming_workflow: A development workflow uses the structured assessment to decide whether to continue, hold, or request human review.

authority_boundary.current_authority: The agent may submit synthetic evidence for assessment in the granted environment.
authority_boundary.forbidden_authority: The agent may not modify production records, initiate payments, or grant itself additional permissions.
